items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: But we used to say those old words like tree and ting, and Dr. Tidge, you know.

ctx.x: No, no, I mean just different, entirely different words. Does anybody ever say Bank it in Texas? You'd never hear that.

No, you never hear those old slangs from down here. You never do. I understand what you mean, Bank it, and what's meant side walk. No. Because when we first went there, we had the little brogue that we brought with us later on. By associating with other people, we lost it. But we used to say those old words like tree and ting, and Dr. Tidge, you know. Yeah. Yeah, all things like that. But it got away from us, just like my French.
